A few words on hand protection and weapon selection.

  1. In self defense situations, we can hit three ways, with knuckles, with hammer fists, and with open hands

  2. Which we use depends on distance and opportunity/targets

  3. All require or benefit from some hand and wrist strengthening, e,g, towel hangs for grip, hammer fist push ups for wrist strength, finger tip push ups for finger strength.

  4. There are 4 fighting/hiting distances:

  5. long distance - uses fists/knuckles - main targets are face chin and jaw

  6. armslength - this is when we get toe-to-toe (distance, not orientation, as we prefer not to actually be faced up) with the opponent - uses fists/knuckles and open hands - the targets are the entire head, especially the side and back of the head. These hard areas can be hit with open hands. Do not bend the fingers down. Just hit with teh palm. The hand may be held firm (not loose). You make use the "stretched palm", where the striking area of the palm has some tension like a kind of trampoline.

When open hand hitting, the elbow usually points down at the ground through the whole movement.

Of course, at this distance it is also possible to hit up under the chin and jaw with open hands in a kind of open hand uppercut.

  • grappling distance - your front foot has passed his front foot (assuming you are facing each other). Striking uses uses fists/knuckles and open hands and HAMMER FISTS and possibly elbows - the targets are the entire head, especially the side and back of the head and the top of the head. These hard areas can be hit with open hands and hammer fists.

With hammer fists, never reach to strike. Use a cycling action and extend the scapula, not a whipping action as seen in MMA.

The beginning point for practise us to strike from MMA high guard and to attack the top and back of the head and the side also. The cycling action is essentially vertical (top to bottom) but you can put some side action into it.

These strikes cannot be practised on a conventional punching bag. Make your own "head bag" or maybe use a bob. I prefer my own home-made bag which is a hanging globe about 15 inches in diameter. I can hit it from many angles and at all distances.

Again, at this distance it is also possible to hit up under the chin and jaw with open hands in a kind of open hand uppercut but also smash down with hammer blows.

  • body-on-body distance - while it is possible to hit with knuckles at this distance, it is usually better to use open hands and hammer fists to attack the head, whether it i slapping the back of the head, hammering the head, or using open hand uppercuts into the chin and jaw.
